messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Zepbound and Mounjaro
Eli Lilly and Company.
Marketed by: Lilly USA, LLC, Indianapolis, IN 46285, USA.
Triplet: ["Zepbound", "marketed by", "Lilly USA, LLC"]

The relation 'marketed by' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is marketed or sold by the entity specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
B. 'has brand name': The subject drug is marketed under the brand or trade name specified by the object entity.
C. 'has formulation': The subject drug is available in the specific formulation specified by the object entity.
D. 'has generic name': The subject drug is sold under or known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
E. 'has use indication': The subject drug may be used for the medical purpose or indication specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
